description.zh:
终端设备ID。取值：
- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~)：查询用户终端设备详情。
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备。
description.en:
The endpoint device ID. You can call the following operations to obtain the device ID:
- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user endpoint device.
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Queries multiple user endpoint devices.

title.zh: 查询用户终端设备详情

descriptions.zh: 单次最多删除100台设备。每台设备的设备状态必须是离线或长期离线状态，若传入的终端设备ID集合中部分设备状态不符，则仅删除状态符合的设备，接口仍返回成功。
descriptions.en: You can delete up to 100 devices at a time. Each device must be in the Offline or LongTermOffline state. If some device IDs in the request do not meet the status requirement, only the devices that meet the requirement are deleted, and the operation still returns a success response.
